A favorite tool of chemists in the upper district. Well suited for dilution and similar tasks.
This barely qualifies as a business card. It's just a torn scrap of white paper.
Unpack to obtain a batch of higher-quality basic chemical supplies.\nStandard chemical supplies commonly found in laboratories in the middle and upper districts.
Higher-purity chemical supplies that are hard to obtain through ordinary channels.
Starts with a capacity of 750 ml. Expandable up to 9000 ml.\nUse chemical supplies or an empty flask to add 750 ml; restricted chemical supplies add 1500 ml.\nUse [Toggle] to change its appearance.
Varied shapes and a clear view of the contents make this flask well suited for storing chemicals.\nAutomatically names itself after its contents.

A dropper with precisely adjustable capacity.
Use the mouse wheel to adjust capacity (100 μL–10 ml).
Continuous scrolling increases the adjustment step.
Each successful dispense uses 1 durability point.
A knockoff made by chemists in the middle district. Keeping impurities out took all they had. Not much to look at and not built to last.
Use [Toggle] to select a chemical grade label.\nHold the mouse button and drag across chemicals to apply labels continuously.
A dropper with precisely adjustable capacity.\nUse the mouse wheel to adjust capacity (100 μL–10 ml).\nContinuous scrolling increases the adjustment step.
A favorite tool of chemists in the upper district. Works well. Costs a lot.
A locked crate with its label deliberately rubbed off. Packed with supplies. Requires a keycard to open.
Odd. You've never seen a crate like this on the station. Where did it come from?
A disposable keycard for an unidentified entity. Unlocks Unknown Medical Crates.
A module that lets a Crypto Desequencer write Unknown Medical access permissions to a blank keycard.
Have you got any more ready?
You're a good person. Thank you.
Are you serious? This is practically charity!
All right. But just this once.
Then I'll have to prepare a little less.
Then I can arrange for a little more.
I don't think we can do business right now.
All right. We have a deal.
Including the ones you have "trouble selling".
But you'll need to show some "goodwill" too.
It's better for both of us.
Don't try any tricks. I know this game better than you do.
